title: agg.emerging_skills message
description: Produced by S9 once per closed day: Unmapped Skill mentions seen often in one country over the 30 days ending on day. Candidates for the Skill Taxonomy; never shown on maps.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; also the Kafka message key

count.description: Lossy Counting estimate (never more than the true count)

max_error.description: Upper bound on how much count may be below the true count
